project_name: Low-Resource Personalized Atypical Speech Recognition Using Hybrid Quantum-Classical Deep Learning for Reliable Emergency Communication

gate_a.scientific_finding: No statistically supported quantum advantage under tested protocol

gate_b_2.application_finding: Local controlled research demonstration operating on served Phase 7.5 adapter

gate_c.reason: Requires lawfully acquired external atypical cohort, executed DUA, institutional IRB approval, clinical SLP oversight, and public OSF preregistration

gate_d.reason: Clinical and emergency safety unproven; requires prospective clinical trials, IEC 62304 / ISO 14971 QMS controls, and regulatory clearance

codebase_hardening_records.nature_of_change: Fail-closed guardrail hardening against synthetic data and TORGO overlap
codebase_hardening_records.description: Expanded SYNTHETIC_PATH_KEYWORDS (19 keywords), expanded synth_col_keys (22 columns) and synth_val_indicators (21 values), added provenance metadata inspection rejecting synthetic cohorts, added empty/whitespace audio path check, and enforced uppercase TORGO speaker ID matching.

codebase_hardening_records.nature_of_change: Single-pass execution race condition and lock integrity hardening
codebase_hardening_records.description: Implemented atomic temporary file replacement (.replace()) for confirmatory lock writing and pre-write existence check raising SINGLE_PASS_RACE_CONDITION.

codebase_hardening_records.nature_of_change: Regression tests for hardened dataset validation guardrails
codebase_hardening_records.description: Added 5 unit tests verifying case-insensitive TORGO overlap, multi-column synthetic schema detection, provenance metadata synthesis rejection, advanced keyword synthesis rejection, and empty audio path rejection. Gate C test suite increased from 12 to 17 tests.
